name: Tingyi (Cayman Islands) Holding Corp.
summary: Tingyi (Cayman Islands) Holding Corp. manufactures and distributes instant noodles, beverages, and instant food products in the People's Republic of China. The company's product portfolio includes a variety of noodle flavors, ready-to-drink teas, bottled water, and confectionery products, and it is headquartered in Tianjin, China. Tingyi's products are widely available across China through a vast distribution network.
